purpose: Guard the Meeting Attendance screens against calling Firebase callable functions that cannot be deployed in the Firebase Spark project.

repairWindow.source: Existing active Meeting Portal repair window

legacyCallableExportsRemainServerSideOnl: functions/meetingRecords.js: legacy onCall exports for meeting records and working documents
findings.disposition: No attendance screen or attendance client module invokes Firebase callable APIs. The UI actions below use authenticated Cloudflare Worker routes; signing uses the existing Signature Portal API.

actionRouting.action: Self / automatic attendance registration and host status update
Retrieve or refresh daily attendance sheet
Mark daily attendance Present / Absent / Excused
Prepare / resume controlled attendance signing dispatch
Create and start email-link attendance signing

prohibitedChanges: No Firebase Cloud Functions deployment or server callable changes.

No Firestore rules, signing rules, tokens, link format, sessions, signer identity, field assignment, stamping, PDF, hash, certificate, archive logic, secrets, environment variables, SMTP settings or branch protection changes.
tests: No httpsCallable/getFunctions/server Functions imports in MeetingRoom, Meetings, MeetingEntryGateway, and attendance/signature client modules.
Self/host marking, daily sheet retrieval/marking, quorum and dispatch each map to a registered Worker route and handler.
Attendance signing uses the existing Signature Portal API; no Firebase callable invocation.
expectedEffect: A future attendance-screen dependency on an undeployed callable fails CI. Existing Worker routes and Signature Portal workflow remain the execution paths.

validation.deployment: After merge, deploy using the existing no-secret-sync Worker and frontend workflows. Do not deploy Firebase Functions.
